summary: Conservative engine map for the ui_platform_and_options scope built from two independent proposals. The strongest grounding is the options/settings tree initializer 0x004AA270 (DERIVED owner PlayerOptions under caller 0x004A70E0), the vtable-installing destructor 0x00494470, the device state-18 setter 0x00554560, and the mutex-guarded thread suspend 0x005855E0. The two remaining functions — the 15-double constraint-compliance matrix builder 0x004364A0 and the settings-path builder 0x004A1EC0 — are GUESS-class helpers with no evidence of shared ownership with the options platform. Two subsystems are emitted (the options platform and the two standalone helpers) rather than one merged scope grouping, because the source proposals explicitly report no common ownership. One function, 0x004A1EC0, receives two incompatible roles across the proposals (SettingsGroupBuilder interface vs SettingsPathBuilder class) and is recorded as a conflict, not resolved by fiat. Trust limited to DERIVED/GUESS/UNKNOWN.

engine_subsystems.name: UiPlatformAndOptions
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Options/settings UI platform: builds and owns the player options tree (named category groups of typed 9-dword entries, string-field registrations, default control-action key bindings, root enable flag life-cycle), destroys UI objects through a vtable-installing base-chain destructor, sets device state 18 via a vtable+252 dispatch, and suspends an AI thread under mutex. Functions grouped here by the source proposal scope; the destructor, device setter, and thread suspend have UNKNOWN owners and the thread-suspend function is flagged by the packet as belonging to the ai subsystem.

engine_subsystems.name: UiPlatformHelpers
engine_subsystems.responsibility: Two evidence-unrelated helpers delivered under the ui_platform_and_options scope: builds the 15-double (0x78-byte) constraint compliance matrix (0x004364A0) and builds a settings file path from the application directory, a base path, a player identifier and a suffix, forwarding it to 0x004A1B70 (0x004A1EC0). No shared ownership with the options platform is evidenced; both owners are reported as UnknownObject by the source proposals.

canonical_type_families.name: PlayerOptions
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Owns and initializes the player options / settings tree: named category groups of 9-dword option entries, string-field registrations, control-action default key bindings, and the root enable flag life-cycle. Built by 0x004AA270 under UIControlWindowInitialization (0x004A70E0).
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No fields emitted. The option-entry layout (label char*, value/min/max/selector dwords, description char*, offsets 0x0..0x14 of a 36-byte entry, plus three trailing unproven dwords) is inferred from recurring 4-dword writes in the raw source but carries no field: evidence refs in the packet, so it is preserved as a boundary clue in contract PlayerOptionsTreeLayout rather than emitted as fields. Float bit-pattern defaults (e.g. 1065353216, 1058642330) are raw literals whose decimal meaning is DERIVED only.

canonical_type_families.name: ConstraintComplianceMatrix
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Holds the 15-double (0x78-byte) constraint compliance matrix written by 0x004364A0 as products of input scalars and a5 vector components, plus two rows normalized by 1/sqrt(a2); returns nonzero iff any of the first 13 entries is non-zero. Entry semantics are defined by caller 0x0043C250. The class boundary itself is inferred because the packet owner is UnknownObject.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: 15 contiguous double fields at this+0x0..+0x70 (0x78-byte buffer) written by a single function. Field samples are boundary clues from one writer, not a confirmed complete layout; the 3x5 interpretation and the two normalized rows are synthesis over packet operations. Preserve proposal:class:wave_001_ui_platform_and_options_01:0 as the source class ref; do not promote to a confirmed source-level type.

canonical_type_families.name: SettingsPathBuilder
canonical_type_families.responsibility: Constructs a settings file path in a local buffer by concatenating the application directory (byte_5EA438), the base file path (asc_5CD148), a caller-supplied player-specific identifier, and the file suffix (asc_5CD144), then passes it to 0x004A1B70 and returns that call's result. The buffer is local (not evidenced as a field), so no class fields are proposed.
canonical_type_families.field_policy: No fields emitted: the path buffer is local and no this-referenced fields are evidenced for 0x004A1EC0. Do not infer an instance layout from the concatenation order alone.

states.name: Active
states.description: state-18 value 1 dispatched for a2 == 1 when 0x008B8C48 bit 0 clear

states.name: ActiveForced
states.description: state-18 value 2 dispatched for a2 == 1 when 0x008B8C48 bit 0 set

states.name: OtherValue
states.description: a2 values other than 0/1 stored at this+0x34 without dispatch

transitions.action: dispatch vtable+252 on 0x008B89A0 with state 18; record this[13] = a2
FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate sets root enable flag to 1
FlagSetterWithGlobalUpdate clears root enable flag to 0, then EmptyStub finalizer

interfaces.name: SettingsGroupBuilder
interfaces.purpose: Builds the named category path (e.g. Scene, Driver, SoundOptions) under which option entries are registered. Conflicting with the SettingsPathBuilder class proposal for the same function 0x004A1EC0; see conflicts.

interfaces.name: StringFieldRegistrar
interfaces.purpose: Registers a string-valued field into the current settings group (used for scene file, profile vehicle, telemetry exe/file, GDB filename, player livery).

compatibility_contracts.name: UIObjectLifetime
compatibility_contracts.description: UI object destruction must install vtable 0x005AC830 at this+0x0, chain to the base UI destructor (0x00485EB0), and when the flag argument has bit 0 set free the object allocation via FreeWrapper_7bcf; the call still returns this.

compatibility_contracts.name: DeviceState18Set
compatibility_contracts.description: Setting device state 18 for a2 0/1 must dispatch through vtable+252 on the object at global 0x008B89A0 (state 18, value 0 / 1-or-2 depending on bit 0 of global byte 0x008B8C48), skip when a2 == -1 or equals the last applied value, and record the last applied value at this+0x34.

compatibility_contracts.name: PlayerOptionsTreeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: The options/settings tree is populated as named category groups (Scene, Driver, DrivingAids, RaceConditions, SoundOptions, GraphicOptions, GameOptions, MultiplayerOptions, Options, Controls); each option entry is a 9-dword (36-byte) group holding a label, value/min/max/selector dwords and a description string; indexed lists use 7-entry loops with per-index formatted names; all control actions are bound to default key codes; the root enable flag is set to 1 at start and cleared to 0 at end.

compatibility_contracts.name: ConstraintMatrixLayoutAndReturn
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x004364A0 must write 15 doubles into the this-referenced buffer at offsets +0x0..+0x70 (contiguous 0x78-byte layout) and return a non-zero value exactly when any of the first 13 entries (this[0]..this[12]) is non-zero. Caller 0x0043C250 relies on both the written matrix and the return value.

compatibility_contracts.name: SettingsPathConcatenationOrder
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement for 0x004A1EC0 must build the settings path by concatenating, in order: the application directory string (byte_5EA438), the base file path (asc_5CD148), the caller-supplied player identifier, and the file suffix (asc_5CD144); it must then call 0x004A1B70 with the completed path and propagate that call's return value. The referenced globals must remain readable as string data in the same order.

conflicts.subject: Function 0x004A1EC0 dual role
alternatives: SettingsGroupBuilder: named category-path builder for option-entry registration (proposal ui_platform_and_options_01, interface, DERIVED)
SettingsPathBuilder: settings file-path builder concatenating app dir + base path + player id + suffix, forwarded to 0x004A1B70 (proposal wave_001_ui_platform_and_options_01, class, GUESS)
conflicts.resolution: Not merged. The two proposals assign the same function incompatible responsibilities and backing evidence (category-registration path vs settings-file path). Emitted as both an interface (SettingsGroupBuilder, DERIVED) and a GUESS class (SettingsPathBuilder) with the contradiction retained; further evidence (callers, string data at 0x005CD144/0x005CD148) decides ownership.

conflicts.subject: Scope ownership boundary for 0x005855E0
alternatives: ai subsystem (packet's own description of the function)
conflicts.resolution: Left unresolved: owner remains UnknownObject. The mutex-guarded thread suspend is grouped into the ui_platform_and_options subsystem only because the packet delivered it there; its ai-subsystem affinity is recorded in the subsystem responsibility. Do not assign the function to the PlayerOptions family.

conflicts.subject: Subsystem name collision across proposals
conflicts.resolution: Emitted as two subsystems (UiPlatformAndOptions, UiPlatformHelpers) because the proposals share a scope name but report no common ownership and no shared responsibility. Neither merge nor erasure; the two bodies of work stay separate until ownership evidence connects them.
